summary:
Main
Iron ore prices diverged across domestic and seaborne markets today. DCE most-traded closed at 687.5 yuan/mt, down 0.51%.The 61% and 65% port indices each lost 2 yuan, the 58% held steady, and all eight spot products declined. The seaborne 61% and 65% composite indices rose to USD 91.95 and 107.95/dmt, while all 12 brands gained USD 0.20/dmt against the previous report.
